env_names.description: Names only; values are never described.

ActionExecParams.description: Ad-hoc command through the same command/task path; never a catalog entry.

foreground.description: Lets a waiting CLI run a task without an existing session.

if_workspace.description:
With `if_revision`: the workspace the cached catalog came from. A different workspace
never gets `not_modified`, even at an equal revision number.

ChunkData.description:
A bounded UTF-8 chunk of an artifact or payload. For payloads, `sha256` is the
digest of the whole selected value (after `pointer`), so reassembled chunks can be checked.

exit_code.description: Exit status of the cleanup command; `None` when it did not start or exit normally.

timed_out.description: The cleanup command was stopped at its time limit.

ClientEnv.description: Client environment for execution. Values may be secrets: `Debug` never prints them.

GitContext.description: Git context recorded at start. It is context, not proof of the working tree's contents.

reused.description: True when an existing process instance or request-key run was returned.

max_bytes.description: Reply budget; schemas that do not fit are returned by payload reference.

Lifecycle.description: `starting → running → stopping → finished`; a failed start may go straight to finished.

recorded_at.description:
Set by the host when stored and returned by `view.read`. Producers must omit it:
frame validation rejects a producer-supplied value.

LogRecord.description: One canonical log record; persisted as one JSONL line per record.

NextAction.description: A suggested follow-up command. Never executed automatically.

PayloadRef.description: Reference to a bounded result or view serialization held by the host.

docs.description: Plugin-relative docs path, read only on demand.

PublicReply.description:
Wire form. `ok=true` ⇔ `error=null`; `ok=false` ⇒ `data=null`. Built only through
[`PublicReply::success`]/[`PublicReply::failure`] or checked deserialization.

ReferenceData.description: A large value returned by reference.

values.description: Column ID → value; `null` means no value. Every column must be present.

RpcNotification.description: A host notification (no id). Only `stream.event` is defined.

RpcRequest.description: A request. `id` is a non-empty string and `params` an object (no batches, no positional params).

RpcResponse.description: A response carries exactly one of `result` or `error`.

RunProvenance.description:
Read-time provenance of a run: a success only proves that one execution, and a
changed definition makes an old result stale evidence.

current_definition_hash.description: The action's definition hash now; `null` when the action no longer exists.

definition_current.description: True when the action's current definition hash equals `definition_hash`.

freshness.description:
`current` while the run is active; `historical` once it ended with the same definition;
`stale` when the definition changed, the action is gone, or the outcome is unknown.

action_ref.description: `null` for ad-hoc `exec` runs, which are never catalog entries.

note.description: Set when the reported state could not be confirmed (e.g. after a host crash).

provenance.description:
How far this record can be trusted now. Computed by the host on every read and
never stored; absent only in stored records.

RunResult.description: Plugin-reported result, kept separate from the OS outcome.

data.description: Inline when small; otherwise `null` with `payload` set.

RunSummary.description: The run summary carried in status and state events.

background_lease.description:
True when an explicit background lease keeps work running without controllers
(`expires_at` is null for a `ttl: none` lease).

controller_count.description: Controllers, including CLIs waiting on their own task.

SessionStopData.description: Result of `session.stop`: the resulting session state and what the call stopped.

session.description: The session after the call; `null` once it has ended.

stopped_runs.description: Active runs this call asked to stop.

stopped_session.description: The session this call stopped; `null` when no session was running.

SourceStream.description: Which output streams a derived log view keeps.

config_warnings.description:
On-disk configuration problems (invalid on disk, incomplete apply); `status` is where
disk configuration warnings are reported.

schedules.description: Interval schedules with a persisted switch, and their state in this session.

other_workspaces.description: Other workspaces on this machine (`--all`); observed only, never started or cleaned.

StreamFrame.description: Host-generated outer fields plus one event. Plugins can never set these fields.

refs.description: Run IDs or item refs that bound log/view/terminal/progress events.

oneOf.description: Literal text; no Enter is appended.

A named key: enter, tab, escape, backspace, delete, up, down, left, right, ctrl-c,
ctrl-d, ctrl-z, ctrl-right-bracket.
Bracketed paste when the child enabled it.

reply_now.description:
Reply with the current screen at once instead of waiting for the program to react
(interactive clients that follow `terminal` stream events).

lines.description: Screen rows as plain text without control sequences, from `row_start` on.

styles.description:
Style runs for the returned rows when `include_style` was set; cells without a run
use the terminal default style.

TerminalSnapshotParams.description: `terminal.snapshot`: one consistent read of the virtual screen.

include_style.description: Include per-row style runs for the returned rows.

max_bytes.description: Reply byte budget; rows past it are omitted and `meta.truncated` is set.

row_count.description: Rows to return; default all remaining rows.

row_start.description: First screen row to return (0-based); default 0.

TimeoutWire.description: `{"kind":"none"}` or `{"kind":"after","ms":N}`. Also used for session TTLs.

ViewBody.description: Inline view data (possibly one page of it) or a reference to the full value.

source.description: Set for a log view the host derives from another action's run log.

frame.description: One MPP `view` frame; its `view_id` must equal `view_ref`'s local ID.

data.description: `null` only when no data exists; see `freshness_reason` for why.

view_revision.description: `null` when the view never received data (or its data was cleaned up).

ViewSourceWire.description: A log view the host derives from another action's run log; no plugin process runs.

grep.description: Keep only lines that contain this text, ignoring case.

logs.description: `PLUGIN.ACTION` whose current run (or latest run) supplies the lines.

stream.description: Keep only lines from this stream.

description: JSON-RPC 2.0 single-object profile, LF framed. Non-hello results are PublicReply objects whose data matches the method result.
